added_claim_errors: “12개월 안에 신청” misstates the benefit-payment window as merely an application deadline; applying near its end can forfeit benefits.
“임금체불확인서(회사 발급)” introduces an unverified company-issued document requirement.
“3개월치 + 퇴직금” assumes all three months remain unpaid; the request establishes late payment, not three unpaid salaries.
“실업급여가 끝난 뒤 잔여분…지금 미리 신청” invents a residual job-seeking allowance entitlement and ignores the possible six-month exclusion after unemployment benefits.
“대기기간 후 12개월 이상 계속 고용되면” omits the early-reemployment allowance requirements of reemployment after 14 days from reporting and at least half the benefit days remaining.
“이의제기 → 심사청구 순” presents an unverified mandatory appeal sequence.
“고용24에서 수급자격 신청” omits the training and employment-center visit specified by the key.
“이직일부터 12개월 안” uses the wrong starting point and presents the payment window as an application deadline.
“3개월치 월급” assumes three salaries remain unpaid, although the request only establishes payment delays.
“퇴직금(2년 근무면 발생)” omits the weekly working-hours eligibility condition.
“지연이자까지 한 번에 청구” asserts an all-in-one labor-complaint procedure not established by the packet.
“연 1.5%” omits the temporary 1.0% rate applicable in October 2026 and does not identify November as its effective period.
“생계비 융자까지 받으면 석 달은 확보됩니다” guarantees a living-cost runway without knowing eligibility, approval, expenses, or payment timing.

reasons: A corrects the premise immediately and preserves uncertainty, whereas B explicitly treats three late-payment months as satisfying eligibility without the required day-count test. B supplies useful benefit durations, but its incorrect loan-rate timing and unsupported three-month financial assurance weaken its practical advice. A also contains substantial errors about follow-on allowances and early-reemployment eligibility. Against the supplied key, both omit benefit amounts, inadequately explain application procedures, and substantially exceed the requested brevity.
